title: Substitute
text: Let $$\theta=3sin\left(t\right)$$. Then the integral becomes the integral of $$27sin^3\left(t\right)$$ with respect to $$t$$.

title: Integrate and convert back
text: The integral is $$-27cos\left(t\right)+9cos^3\left(t\right)$$, where cos(t) is $$\frac{\sqrt{9-{\theta}^2}}{3}$$. Substitute and simplify.
